description: Full detail for one product by slug: community sentiment, reference price and basis, date of the latest price observation, portafilter size (machines) or accessory size (sized accessories), superautomatic / manual-lever / hand-grinder flags, product URL and Amazon link. A known product with no price returns price null, the reason, and priced alternatives. An unknown slug returns did_you_mean.
